blocks.text: CAINTA, Rizal — National player JP Macatula scored a perfect game Tuesday, the first achieved in the ongoing 28th Sletba Open Championships at the Sta. Lucia East Bowling Center here. Macatula made the feat, his 17th career 300-game, on lanes 7 and 8 using a 15-pound 900 Global Tough Reality ball. Macatula, who is representing Sletba, was actually doing his qualifying rounds when he posted his perfect game. This feat prompted Sletba officials to note that more exciting qualifying games are in store before the finals begin on Friday, Nov. 6. Three other players nearly scored a perfect game in this […]...
